description:
Start paid LightX relight on an owned source video.

First call estimate_lightx_relight with the same source video and lighting settings. max_cost_rub is
required and must cover the maximum hold. Original source audio is preserved. Returns a job ID; read get_video.
Even a completed job/webhook may have is_hold=true: poll get_video until is_hold=false for final cost.

max_cost_rub.description: Maximum hold confirmed from the LightX relight estimate; never exceeded.
max_cost_rub.title: Max Cost Rub

ref_id.description: Optional frame index (0-48) for reference conditioning.
ref_id.title: Ref Id

reference_image_url.description: Conditioning image from your own uploads or results for ref, hdr, or bg.
reference_image_url.title: Reference Image Url

relight_parameters.description: Required when relit_cond_type='ic'; forbidden for ref, hdr, and bg.

relit_cond_img_url.description: Alias for reference_image_url; if both are set they must match.
relit_cond_img_url.title: Relit Cond Img Url

video_url.description: Source video from your own uploads or results; at least 49/24 seconds and at most 15 seconds.
video_url.title: Video Url

name: create_lightx_relight
